title: Re-enable SRD thaw-note gating at post-o9bd re-freeze
description: Counterpart to eshyra-nsd1 and the temporary GitHub Actions guard removal. When the o9bd epic completes and the SRD 5.1 artifact is re-frozen with a new baseline (squashing the accumulated thaw notes since the umbrella freeze note), restore the GitHub Actions workflow that executes the existing SRD freeze verifier: .github/workflows/srd-freeze-guard.yml. Keep/reuse the existing verifier implementation in packages/core/scripts/verify-dnd5e-srd-freeze/, the package.json verify:dnd5e-srd-freeze script, and packages/core/test/srdFreezeGuard.test.ts. Refresh docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/freeze-manifest.json to status frozen with current hashes and update docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/README.md plus thaw-notes/TEMPLATE.md if needed so they describe the active CI guard accurately. Verify the restored workflow/check fires on a protected-path PR without a thaw note, and verify the hash check passes against the new frozen baseline.
notes:
*** RE-FREEZE BAR REPLACED (2026-07-31) — ADR 0020 NINE-CONDITION MODEL ***
Authority: ADR 0020 and section 5.9 of the integrated transition design
docs/audits/rules-awareness-transition/2026-07-30-integrated-transition-design.md
— the accepted deliverable of eshyra-o9bd.19.8 (PR #485, reviewed head
afd113c7090378c3a9f4122f246a6c32602a5164, merge commit
042ce119aa699f04f60a1885d471335f07745282). Recorded as accepted authority; NOT
implemented in code by this bead update.

THIS BEAD'S POLICY IS RETAINED UNCHANGED (transition design section 5.8): a
change to audited pack bytes is a reviewed event, and restoring
.github/workflows/srd-freeze-guard.yml plus the frozen freeze-manifest baseline
remains exactly this bead's job. The verifier, the npm script, and
srdFreezeGuard.test.ts are unchanged. Enforcement is currently off in three
independent ways (THAW_NOTE_CHECK_ENABLED = false, a red hash check, and the
deleted CI workflow); this bead is what turns it back on.

WHAT CHANGED is the bar the upstream re-freeze (eshyra-o9bd.14) must satisfy
before this bead runs. The withdrawn requirement was "zero engine-pending
deterministic clauses", a global negative the corpus cannot support. The
replacement is the nine-condition truthfulness bar recorded in full on
eshyra-o9bd.14: source fidelity; truthful provenance; deterministic
reproducibility; truthful in-band scope for every audit and readiness artifact;
durable disposition of known findings; correctness of positively selected
capabilities; no known source invention; no unowned live runtime safety
contract; and explicit statement of unresolved discovery and adjudication limits.

Explicitly NOT required before re-freeze or before restoring this gate: global
deterministic closure, universal discovery completeness, zero engine-pending
clauses, or any corpus-wide negative claim. This bead's existing dependency on
eshyra-o9bd.14 is unchanged and remains the only ordering constraint it needs;
the new evidence providers (eshyra-o9bd.19.14 artifact dispositions,
eshyra-o9bd.19.1.15 durable findings, eshyra-olc5.6 capability correctness,
eshyra-o9bd.19.2.1 source authority) are wired on eshyra-o9bd.14 so this bead
inherits them transitively rather than duplicating the graph.
